_comment: Directory of courts: where each one posts calendars, live audio and recordings. 'calendar_status' says whether this site builds that court's upcoming calendar yet.

courts.name: Supreme Court of the United States
courts.listen_note: Recordings are posted on supremecourt.gov the same day as the argument.
